instructions:
1. Set one end of a barbell in a landmine or wedge it into a corner. Stand side-on to the bar with feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Hinge at the hips with a flat back and grip the loaded end with the near hand. Let the arm hang straight.
3. Pull the bar toward your hip by driving the elbow up and back.
4. Squeeze the shoulder blade at the top.
5. Lower under control until the arm is fully extended. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive the elbow back and up rather than just bending the arm.
2. Keep the hips square and brace the core to stop the torso twisting.
3. Keep a flat back throughout to protect the spine.
4. Exhale as you pull, inhale as you lower.
name: Barbell Meadows Row

instructions:
1. Set a barbell across your upper back and grip it slightly wider than shoulder-width.
2. Stand with your feet closer than shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
3. Push your hips back and bend your knees, lowering until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
4. Keep your chest up and back flat throughout.
5. Drive through your heels to stand back up and extend your hips and knees. Repeat.
tips:
1. The narrow stance shifts more load onto the quads, so control the descent.
2. Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
3. Brace your core before each rep to protect the lower back.
4. Inhale on the way down, exhale as you drive up.
name: Barbell narrow stance squat

instructions:
1. Stand with feet hip-width apart with a loaded barbell beside one foot.
2. Hinge at the hips and slightly bend the knees to grip the bar with one hand, keeping the back flat.
3. Keep the bar close to your body and your shoulders square.
4. Drive through your heels and extend your hips and knees to stand upright.
5. Lower the bar under control by hinging back at the hips. Switch arms. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the bar close to your leg for a strong, efficient pull.
2. Brace your core hard to stop your torso twisting toward the loaded side.
3. Keep your shoulders level and back flat throughout.
4. Exhale as you stand, inhale as you lower.
name: Barbell one arm single deadlift

instructions:
1. Sit with your upper back against a bench, knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Rest a padded barbell across your hips.
2. Lift one leg and extend it out in front of you.
3. Drive through the heel of the planted foot to raise your hips until your body forms a straight line.
4. Squeeze your glutes hard at the top and hold briefly.
5. Lower your hips under control, stopping just before they touch the floor. Switch legs. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive through the heel to bias the glutes.
2. Squeeze the glutes at the top rather than arching the lower back.
3. Keep your chin tucked and ribs down to stabilize the spine.
4. Use a pad on the bar for comfort on the hips.
name: Barbell one leg hip thrust

instructions:
1. Hold a barbell overhead with arms locked out, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Brace your core and keep the bar stacked over your shoulders.
3. Step forward with one leg and lower until both knees are bent and the back knee hovers above the floor.
4. Drive through the front heel to return to the start.
5. Repeat with the other leg, alternating sides. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the bar directly over your shoulders, not drifting forward.
2. Brace your core to resist the torso tipping under the overhead load.
3. Keep the front shin near vertical and the chest tall.
4. Move slowly and stay balanced on each step.
name: Barbell overhead lunges
